name: retro-cache
description: The retrocausal cache, audited into a tariff ledger. The countersigned verdict said: it is a correlator, not an oracle, and the no-signaling tax is not in the visitor's depreciation table and cannot be depreciated away. This repo prints that tax as a ledger: (W1) correlation inventory — Werner-singlet joint tables P(x,y|a,b) = (1 - xy p a.b)/4 on two arithmetic paths, CHSH = 2*sqrt(2)*p to machine precision, complex phase-family anchors Phi_theta with E = cos(theta)(ax bx - ay by) that catch conjugation bugs; (W2) the marginal tariff — B's outcome distribution is exactly (1/2,1/2) under any axis, any visibility, and any local map (random unitary, Stinespring CPTP, classical postprocessing), while the joint state visibly moves; mutual information with A's side is exactly 0 bits before the broadcast and exactly 1 bit after it — the before/after, in bits; (W3) the pre-arrival equivalence theorem at machine level — before the classical channel, the quantum cache is distributionally indistinguishable (TV = 0) from a pre-shared random seed, and the ENTIRE surplus lives in the joint column: all 256 deterministic classical shared-randomness strategies cap CHSH at exactly 2 (full enumeration), the singlet reaches 2*sqrt(2); (W4) the withdrawal ledger — aligned-axes extraction: QBER = (1-p)/2 two-path, sifting rate 1/2, reconciliation floor h2(QBER) (SHAN48), net = (1 - h2(q))/2 bits per pair, settings tariff 1 bit per raw pair on the classical channel, zero net at p = 0 — the exchange rate of cache withdrawal, exact and priced; (W5, v0.2.0) bounded privacy amplification at BB84-grade toy scale — explicit universal-2 field-multiplication hash family over GF(2^8)/GF(2^4) with exhaustive collision census, Eve-surviving information measured before/after on exact 256x256 joint tables for smoothed (BSC footprint-attribution) and sparse (intercept-resend) adversary profiles, the key-rate curve r(p) vs the 1-h2(q) line as data with honest gap accounting (identity compression ties the data-processing ceiling, leftover-hash bound printed where vacuous, no composable claim); (W6, v0.2.0) the adversary census — intercept-resend taps, noisy-storage memories, and settings mutations priced in the tariff ledger on exact two-path tables: attacked QBER (1-eta/2)(1-p)/2 + eta/4, attacked CHSH (1-eta/2)2*sqrt(2)p sinking into the 256-strategy census cap at eta* = 2 - sqrt(2)/p, mutation priced dead loss on the zero-information settings column, the full tap confiscated by the reconciliation floor
